description: MACD Indicator: Add Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) technical indicator with dedicated sub-panel. Follows the established IndicatorPanel pattern from RSI (Feature 3) and leverages ChartContext architecture (Feature 5).
principles: Rock-solid quality over speed - every feature must be bulletproof before moving on
Comprehensive test coverage - unit tests, integration tests, edge cases
All tests must pass before a story is marked complete
Follow established patterns - reuse IndicatorPanel and ChartContext
Apply learnings from AGENTS.md and RSI implementation
MACD uses NEGATIVE scale (-10 to +10 typical) unlike RSI (0-100)

background.macdOverview: MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) is a trend-following momentum indicator that shows the relationship between two moving averages of a security's price.

macdComponents.signal_line: 9-period EMA of the MACD line (slow line, trigger)
macdComponents.histogram: MACD line minus Signal line (visual representation of divergence)

macdInterpretation.bullish_crossover: MACD crosses above Signal line (potential buy signal)
macdInterpretation.bearish_crossover: MACD crosses below Signal line (potential sell signal)
macdInterpretation.divergence: Price makes new high/low but MACD doesn't (trend reversal warning)
macdInterpretation.zero_line: MACD crossing zero indicates trend direction change

existingFoundation: IndicatorPanel base class (VPR-038) - handles rendering, reference lines, braille charts
ChartContext (Feature 5) - provides chart_area_width for perfect alignment
EMA calculation (VPR-034) - needed for MACD and Signal line
RSI implementation (VPR-039) - pattern to follow for MACD

keyDifferences.scale: MACD uses centered scale around zero (-10 to +10 typical) vs RSI (0-100)
keyDifferences.components: MACD has 3 visual elements (line, signal, histogram) vs RSI (1 line)
keyDifferences.reference_lines: MACD needs zero line, RSI has overbought/oversold at 70/30
keyDifferences.height: MACD needs more height (7 lines) due to histogram + lines vs RSI (4 lines)

userStories.title: Implement prefix keybinding system for technical indicators
acceptanceCriteria: Implement prefix key system: 't' (technical) as first key, then indicator-specific key
Add _technical_prefix_active: bool flag to track if 't' was pressed
On 't' key press: set flag, show temporary hint in status bar ('Technical: r=RSI, a=MA')
On second key press: route to indicator action, clear flag
If any other key pressed after 't', clear flag (cancel prefix)
Refactor existing 'm' keybinding: remove from BINDINGS, implement as 't-a' action
Refactor existing 'r' keybinding: remove from BINDINGS, implement as 't-r' action
cycle_ma_display() now triggered by 't-a' sequence
toggle_rsi() now triggered by 't-r' sequence
Each indicator action requires full prefix (t-a, t-a to cycle MA again)
Update help_screen.py: document 't' prefix system, update RSI and MA keybindings
Test: 't-r' toggles RSI on/off
Test: 't-a' cycles MA (off → SMA20 → SMA50 → both → off)
Test: pressing 't' then any non-indicator key clears prefix state
All existing indicator functionality works with new prefix system
userStories.notes: Establishes the prefix key pattern BEFORE adding MACD. Refactors existing indicator keybindings (RSI, MA) to use 't' prefix. This story has NO MACD code - just the keybinding infrastructure. Thoroughly test with existing indicators.

userStories.title: Add MACD calculation to indicators service
acceptanceCriteria: New function: calculate_macd(prices, fast_period=12, slow_period=26, signal_period=9)
Returns tuple: (macd_line, signal_line, histogram) - all list[float | None]
MACD line: EMA(fast) - EMA(slow) using existing calculate_ema()
Signal line: 9-period EMA of MACD line
Histogram: macd_line[i] - signal_line[i] for all i
Handle None values: propagate None through calculations
First 33 values are None: (26-1) + (9-1) + 1 = 33
Validation: fast_period < slow_period, all periods > 0
Raise ValueError for invalid periods
100% test coverage on new function
Tests: basic calculation, edge cases (empty, single point, flat prices), known values
Test: verify None count is exactly 33 for default periods
Test: MACD can be negative (unlike RSI which is 0-100)
userStories.notes: Pure calculation function, no UI. Reuse calculate_ema() from VPR-034. MACD can be negative, unlike RSI. First 33 values are None because: 25 None from slow EMA + 8 None from signal EMA = 33 total.

macdCalculation.formula: MACD = EMA(12) - EMA(26), Signal = EMA(MACD, 9), Histogram = MACD - Signal
macdCalculation.none_count: First 33 values are None: (26-1 for slow EMA) + (9-1 for signal EMA) + 1 for first subtraction = 33
calculation_steps: 3. Calculate macd_line = fast_ema[i] - slow_ema[i] for each i
5. Calculate histogram = macd_line[i] - signal_line[i] for each i
macdCalculation.negative_values: MACD line, signal, and histogram can all be negative - handle in rendering
macdCalculation.none_handling: If either fast_ema[i] or slow_ema[i] is None, macd_line[i] is None. Propagate None through all calculations.

histogramRendering.approach: Use vertical bars similar to volume bars, but centered at zero line instead of bottom-aligned
histogramRendering.positive_bars: Render above zero line in green (bullish signal)
histogramRendering.negative_bars: Render below zero line in red (bearish signal)
histogramRendering.character_set: Use block characters: ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ for varying heights
histogramRendering.alignment: Histogram bars should align with MACD/Signal line data points horizontally
histogramRendering.zero_line: Histogram extends up/down from zero line, not from bottom of panel

panelConfiguration.height: 7 lines (RSI uses 4, MACD needs more for histogram + 2 lines)
panelConfiguration.scale: min_value=-10.0, max_value=10.0 (typical range, adjust if data exceeds)
panelConfiguration.histogram_colors: green for positive, red for negative

integrationPattern.compose_order: yield chart_content, yield rsi_panel, yield macd_panel (stacks vertically)
integrationPattern.cache_values: Store _macd_line, _signal_line, _histogram to avoid recalculation on toggle
integrationPattern.minimum_data: MACD requires 34 prices minimum (33 None + 1 value)
integrationPattern.context_passing: Pass ChartContext to show_macd() for chart_area_width alignment
integrationPattern.stale_data_prevention: Update MACD panel in show_chart() even when panel hidden
integrationPattern.visibility_management: Use panel.hide() and panel.show() or panel.toggle_visibility()

prefixKeySystem.implementation: Track first key press in app state, then route second key to appropriate action
prefixKeySystem.stateless: Each indicator action requires full prefix (t-a, t-a to cycle MA, not mode-based)
prefixKeySystem.extensibility: Future: t-s (Stochastic), t-b (Bollinger Bands), t-v (Volume indicators)
prefixKeySystem.preserve_existing: Keep i for info panel, c for chart, n for news, w for watchlist commands
